research_question.note: Set by the funder's call; hamlet committees were told the question, not asked.

what_counts_as_evidence.note: GPS points from the team; usability ratings designed with the committees.

interpretation.note: Two validation meetings per hamlet before the draft report.

dissent.note: Committees can append a dissent note to the report; two did.

after_the_project.note: Maps handed to the gram panchayat; no further funding.
